description: This Java class defines the HttpRequestTemplateObject, a data model representing an HTTP request template with various request attributes such as method, path, headers, cookies, body, and connection details. It includes constructor logic to initialize from an HttpRequest object and methods for access, equality, and cloning.

classes.name: HttpRequestTemplateObject
classes.description: A data model class representing an HTTP request template with various request attributes and methods for initialization, access, and comparison.

methods.name: HttpRequestTemplateObject

methods.description: Returns the HTTP method of the request.
